title: The Coup
one_paragraph_synopsis: In this episode, Michael initiates Movie Monday to boost office morale, but Jan disapproves, concerned about productivity. Angela fears repercussions and urges Dwight to confront Jan. Dwight seizes the opportunity to propose taking over the branch, leading to Michael demoting himself and appointing Dwight as acting manager. Tensions rise with conflicts between Michael and Dwight, including disputes over a car and leadership decisions. Despite moments of reconciliation, uncertainty remains about the success of Dwight's leadership and the office's future dynamics.
